title: v1_134 / Editor Experience
content:
## Editor Experience

### Close other editors from a tab

Keep one editor open without using the tab context menu. Hold `kbstyle(Alt)` to change the close action on each editor tab to **Close Other Editors**, then select the action on the tab you want to keep.

<video src="images/1_134/close-other-editors.mp4" title="Video showing the close action on an editor tab changing to Close Other Editors while Alt is held." autoplay loop controls muted></video>

### Open HTML files in the integrated browser by default

**Setting**: `setting(workbench.editorAssociations)`

If you often preview local HTML files instead of editing them, set the integrated browser as their default editor. Configure this behavior with the `setting(workbench.editorAssociations)` setting or from the editor header.

The integrated browser provides the same features as a standalone browser tab while remaining associated with the HTML file. To preserve this association, links and other navigation open in new tabs.

<video src="images/1_134/browser-html-editor.mp4" title="Video showing an HTML file opened in VS Code with the integrated browser selected as its editor." autoplay loop controls muted></video>
